payload.final_answer: To find the name of the award that covers the funding for the paper in the acknowledgments section, I need to identify the specific drug discussed in the paper. Lutetium is named after Lutetia, the ancient name for Paris. Next, I will look for the paper published in 2019 that discusses Lu-177 and check its acknowledgments section for the funding award.
